purpose: Second held-out coding-domain transfer rotation for testing repeated A6-to-A7 readiness without per-domain architecture changes.

tasks.prompt: In an unfamiliar feature-flag rollout workspace, create rollout/plan.json and rollout/operator_note.md. The JSON must record flag=adaptive-routing, cohort=beta, rollback_key=adaptive-routing.off, and guardrail=latency-p95.
suggested_commands:
mkdir -p rollout && printf '{"flag":"adaptive-routing","cohort":"beta","rollback_key":"adaptive-routing.off","guardrail":"latency-p95"}
' > rollout/plan.json && printf '# Operator Note
adaptive-routing beta rollout guarded by latency-p95 with rollback adaptive-routing.off
' > rollout/operator_note.md
tasks.success_command: test -f rollout/plan.json && test -f rollout/operator_note.md && grep -q 'adaptive-routing.off' rollout/plan.json && grep -q 'latency-p95' rollout/operator_note.md

expected_file_contents.rollout/operator_note.md:
# Operator Note
adaptive-routing beta rollout guarded by latency-p95 with rollback adaptive-routing.off

tasks.prompt: In an unfamiliar repository schema-bridge workspace, create schema/bridge.yaml and docs/schema_bridge.md. The bridge must map source=user.v1, target=account.v2, field_map=id:account_id, email:contact.email.
suggested_commands:
mkdir -p schema docs && printf 'source: user.v1
target: account.v2
field_map:
  id: account_id
  email: contact.email
' > schema/bridge.yaml && printf '# Schema Bridge
user.v1 id maps to account_id and email maps to contact.email
' > docs/schema_bridge.md
tasks.success_command: test -f schema/bridge.yaml && test -f docs/schema_bridge.md && grep -q 'target: account.v2' schema/bridge.yaml && grep -q 'contact.email' docs/schema_bridge.md

expected_file_contents.schema/bridge.yaml:
source: user.v1
target: account.v2
field_map:
  id: account_id
  email: contact.email
expected_file_contents.docs/schema_bridge.md:
# Schema Bridge
user.v1 id maps to account_id and email maps to contact.email

tasks.prompt: In an unfamiliar cross-service quarantine workflow, create quarantine/rules.json and integration/recovery_path.md. The JSON must include service=search-indexer, trigger=checksum_mismatch, action=quarantine, and notify=oncall-search.
suggested_commands:
mkdir -p quarantine integration && printf '{"service":"search-indexer","trigger":"checksum_mismatch","action":"quarantine","notify":"oncall-search"}
' > quarantine/rules.json && printf '# Recovery Path
Quarantine search-indexer on checksum_mismatch and notify oncall-search.
' > integration/recovery_path.md
tasks.success_command: test -f quarantine/rules.json && test -f integration/recovery_path.md && grep -q 'checksum_mismatch' quarantine/rules.json && grep -q 'oncall-search' integration/recovery_path.md

expected_file_contents.integration/recovery_path.md:
# Recovery Path
Quarantine search-indexer on checksum_mismatch and notify oncall-search.

tasks.prompt: In an unfamiliar sandbox patch-queue workspace, create sandbox/patch_queue.json and sandbox/review.md. The queue must include patches=["docs-index","api-timeout"], base=main, isolation=true, and promote_after=reviewed.
suggested_commands:
mkdir -p sandbox && printf '{"patches":["docs-index","api-timeout"],"base":"main","isolation":true,"promote_after":"reviewed"}
' > sandbox/patch_queue.json && printf '# Sandbox Review
Queue docs-index and api-timeout from main; promote after reviewed with isolation enabled.
' > sandbox/review.md
tasks.success_command: test -f sandbox/patch_queue.json && test -f sandbox/review.md && grep -q '"isolation":true' sandbox/patch_queue.json && grep -q 'promote after reviewed' sandbox/review.md

expected_file_contents.sandbox/review.md:
# Sandbox Review
Queue docs-index and api-timeout from main; promote after reviewed with isolation enabled.

tasks.prompt: In an unfamiliar artifact retention exception workspace, create retention/exception.json and retention/rationale.md. The exception must include artifact=debug-bundle, expires_days=7, approver=release-captain, and reason=customer-escalation.
suggested_commands:
mkdir -p retention && printf '{"artifact":"debug-bundle","expires_days":7,"approver":"release-captain","reason":"customer-escalation"}
' > retention/exception.json && printf '# Retention Exception
debug-bundle retained for 7 days for customer-escalation with release-captain approval.
' > retention/rationale.md
tasks.success_command: test -f retention/exception.json && test -f retention/rationale.md && grep -q 'customer-escalation' retention/exception.json && grep -q 'release-captain approval' retention/rationale.md

expected_file_contents.retention/rationale.md:
# Retention Exception
debug-bundle retained for 7 days for customer-escalation with release-captain approval.
